actual_contract_trace.fact: Transform.compute_affine passes scale, rotation, translation to Affine3A::from_scale_rotation_translation. That calls Mat3A::from_quat, scales the resulting columns, and stores translation. GlobalTransform stores Affine3A; From<Transform> calls compute_affine. GlobalTransform.mul_transform also calls the local transform compute_affine before affine multiplication. There is no retained original quaternion field in GlobalTransform.

Both displayed backends form x2=2x,y2=2y,z2=2z and products xx,xy,xz,yy,yz,zz,wx,wy,wz. Matrix columns are (1-(yy+zz),xy+wz,xz-wy), (xy-wz,1-(xx+zz),yz+wx), (xz+wy,yz-wx,1-(xx+yy)). The only w uses multiply one of x2,y2,z2.
